While the sensory details (such as the coffee scented with a hint of orange and the puddle of light on the tiles) are well-crafted, the story relies on several overused thriller and mystery tropes that have become cliches. These include the spare key hidden under a flowerpot, a stopped clock in an abandoned house, an ominous warning note, the sudden discovery that a supposedly empty house is actually inhabited (fresh coffee), and the classic cliffhanger ending of a door slamming shut while the protagonist freezes in place.
